title: Can the Patriots Build on Their Electric 2025?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Can the Patriots Build on Their Electric 2025?
sources.description: The New England Patriots went 4-13 in 2024, and then they went 14-3 in 2025. That’s a 10-win increase, tied with the 1998-1999 Colts and the 2007-2008 Dolphins for the biggest year-over-year win increase in NFL history. Seven other teams…
